name: create_node_arg_parser
description: Writes a small argv parser for flags, options, and positionals
prompts: Create args.js exporting parseArgs(argv) (module.exports = { parseArgs }) that parses an array of CLI arguments into {flags, options, positionals}: '--name=value' tokens become options entries {name: 'value'}; bare '--name' tokens become flags entries (a Set or array of names); everything else is a positional, in order. A '--' token stops all parsing - every later token is a positional even if it starts with '--'. Return flags as an array of names in first-seen order.
